title: The Lantern Keep
intro: Rain has stopped. The old keep looms above you, dark except for one window high in the tower.
Legend says whoever reaches that window can leave this world behind.
Type 'help' to see what you can do.

gate.name: Outer Gate
gate.text: You stand before the outer gate of the keep. The portcullis is rusted open just enough to squeeze through. The sky burns orange behind the battlements.

courtyard.name: Courtyard
courtyard.text: A quiet courtyard under a sky full of stars. An old stone well sits in the middle. A door leads east into the library; a dark hall lies to the north.

library.name: Library
library.dark_text: It is pitch black. You can feel shelves of books around you, but you can't see a thing.
library.text: Shelves of crumbling books reach up into the dark. A single candle flickers on the reading desk.

hall.name: Great Hall
hall.text: A long hall lit by two guttering torches. At the far end, a heavy oak door with a brass lock guards the tower stairs.

locked.text: The oak door is locked. There must be a key somewhere.

tower.name: Tower Top
tower.text: At the top of the stairs, the window opens onto a swirling, impossible sky. It pulls at you gently.
tower.ending: You step through the window and fall upward into the light. THE END.

items.lantern: A brass lantern, still half full of oil. It would light up a dark room.
items.key: A heavy brass key, warm to the touch.
